keyOpen.tooltip: Set keybinding(s) to show the network applet menu.

showBand.tooltip: Show which band each network is on (2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz). The band you are currently associated to is shown in brackets.

showSignalPercent.tooltip: Show the numeric signal strength next to the bars.

showChannelWidth.tooltip: Show the channel width in MHz (20 / 40 / 80 / 160). This is a property of a single access point, so for a network on several bands it reflects the strongest one only.

showSecurity.tooltip: Show WPA2 / WPA3 / WPA2-Ent / OWE / Open as text. The padlock icon always shows regardless of this setting.
